a.lede: Gemini's Task mode can help users coordinate calls, log into websites, and even make purchases on the user's behalf.
a.title: Google expands access to Gemini Tasks, which can help with calls, purchases

b.title: Google boosts Gemini's ability to do 'repetitive tasks' on its Mac app
